2023-05-08, 1:56 pm — Caroline and Melanie (Mel):
- Mel swamped with kids/work; planned to swim with kids after chat.
- Caroline attended LGBTQ support group 2023-05-07; especially inspired by transgender stories. Felt happy, thankful, accepted, encouraged to embrace herself.
- Caroline researching education/careers in counseling/mental health to help people with similar experiences. Mel praised empathy/understanding.
- Caroline photo: dog walking past wall painted with woman; Mel admired painting.
- Mel shared her 2022 painting, sunset over lake (called it “lake sunrise”), special to her. Caroline praised color blending. Painting helps Mel express emotions, be creative, relax after long days. Both value self-expression/self-care.

2023-05-25, 1:14 pm:
- Mel ran mental-health charity race 2023-05-20; rewarding/thought-provoking, reinforced importance of care. Caroline proud of her helping/raising awareness.
- Mel prioritizing daily self-care (running, reading, violin) to refresh/stay present for family; work in progress. Kids excited for summer; considering June camping.
- Caroline researching adoption agencies, dreams of family/loving home for children in need. Hopeful with friends’/mentors’ support; knows hard work and single parenting challenges, feels ready to provide safe loving home.
- Agency photo: new-arrival sign and information/domestic building; no name. Chosen for LGBTQ+ adoption inclusivity/support. Mel predicted awesome mom offering love/stability; Caroline grateful.

2023-06-09, 7:55 pm:
- Caroline spoke at school event previous week (exact date unknown) about transgender journey, struggles/growth since coming out; encouraged students’ LGBTQ involvement. Began transitioning around 2020.
- Empowering talk; audience connected/inspired to be allies. Wants trans voice, inclusion/identity conversations, acceptance, understanding, hopeful community; sharing difficult but passes on received support. Both see vulnerable stories as connection/reducing loneliness; Mel praised courage/advocacy.
- Mel’s husband/kids motivate courage, loving support system.
- Caroline’s friends, family, mentors her “rocks.” Photo from previous week’s meetup: group/family posing in yard. Friends known four years since moving from home country around 2019 (Sweden, identified 2023-06-27); supported her through everything, especially tough breakup.
- Mel photos: man/little girl at waterfall; bride holding bouquet; man/woman eating on blanket (outing with games, good food, hanging out).
- Mel married five years (about 2018), wedding feels recent. Caroline wished happy years. Mel cherishes family time, feels alive/happy, makes life worthwhile; Caroline likewise grateful for loved ones: “Family is everything.”

2023-06-27, 10:37 am:
- Caroline photo: hand holding cross-and-heart necklace, treasured childhood gift from grandma in Sweden. Represents love, faith, strength, roots/family support.
- Also treasures friend’s hand-painted bowl for 18th birthday ten years earlier (~2013; implies ~28 in 2023). Loves pattern/colors, art/self-expression. Mel shared stacked patterned bowls photo, not explicitly Caroline’s bowl.
- Mel’s family camped in mountains previous week (exact dates unknown): nature, campfire marshmallows, hiking, amazing summit view. Two younger kids love nature; unforgettable memories, fulfilling June plan.
- Caroline still exploring counseling/mental-health careers, especially trans self-acceptance/mental health; details undecided. Attended LGBTQ+ counseling workshop 2023-06-23: enlightening therapeutic methods/working with trans people; admired professionals’ passion for safe spaces.
- Her journey, support groups/counseling improved life and self-understanding, motivating safe inviting space for others’ growth. Mel praised dedication/passion. Both shared bookshelf/room photos.

2023-07-03, 1:36 pm:
- Caroline attended LGBTQ+ pride parade previous week (late June, exact date unknown). Happy crowd/belonging, amazed community growth. Conversations strengthened motivation to share story/help others, pursue counseling/mental health, give back.
- Mel signed up for pottery class 2023-07-02. Pottery therapeutic, creative, calming, emotionally expressive; more than hobby, huge part of life, clay brings joy. Alongside news shared person holding frisbee photo.
- Mel shared black-and-white flower-design bowl she made in class; took work, proud. Caroline praised beauty/effort, encouraged art for joy/expression.
- Caroline just learning piano; planned transgender conference in July, excited for community/advocacy learning, promised updates. Mel wished fun/learning/safety.

2023-07-06, 8:18 pm:
- Caroline continuing deeper counseling/mental-health career research: tough but rewarding, passionate about helping/positive impact. Mel congratulated following dreams.
- Mel took kids to museum 2023-07-05; dinosaur exhibit favorite, love animals/learning, thought bones cool. Their excitement reminded her why she loves motherhood. Photo actually two children in water play area.
- Caroline building future kids’ library: children’s classics, multicultural stories, educational books; excited to read/open minds. Photo bookcase with books/toys.
- Mel’s childhood favorite “Charlotte’s Web,” lessons of friendship/compassion making difference. Cover photo showed girl and cat.
- Caroline likened lessons to friends/family supporting transition with love, guidance, acceptance; couldn’t have done it without them, instrumental in accepting/growing into true self. Picnic with them previous week (exact date unknown); photo women on park blanket.
- Mel stressed unconditional love; shared family around beach campfire. Family loves beach camping, brings them closer; no trip date.

2023-07-12, 4:33 pm:
- Caroline attended LGBTQ conference 2023-07-10 (fulfilling July plan). Connected with others with similar journeys, welcoming/fully accepting environment; grateful community reinforced fighting for trans rights/awareness. Appreciates rights progress but wants more; Mel celebrated community strength/drive.
- Still exploring counseling/mental-health jobs so people have someone to talk to. Personal mental-health struggles and helpful support motivated helping others on their journeys/support systems. Mel said she will make huge difference.
- Mel shared photo of book cover with gold coin: read it in 2022, reminds her to pursue dreams; title not given.
- Caroline loves reading: books guide/motivate/self-discovery, huge part of journey, encourage perseverance. Favorite guide “Becoming Nicole” by Amy Ellis Nutt, inspiring true story of trans girl/family; connection/hope for own path, highly recommends. Lessons: self-acceptance, finding support, tough times pass, hope/love exist.
- Alongside book recommendation Caroline shared dog sitting in boat on water; mentioned pets bring joy (ownership not stated).
- Mel photos: two little girls sitting on steps with dog; cat lying on floor with head down. Family has pup and kitty, named Luna and Oliver (names given together, not explicitly assigned to species). Sweet/playful, brighten days/liven house, bring smiles/comfort.
- Mel bought running shoes: photos person wearing pink sneakers on white rug and pink sneakers in box; Caroline called color purple, asked walking/running.
- Mel running longer/farther since last chat to de-stress/clear mind; great headspace/mental-health improvement, intends to continue. Caroline encouraged her, emphasized prioritizing mental health/self-care.

Caroline (C) and Melanie (M), close supportive friends; attended Pride festival together with friends in 2022 (photo recalled 2023-08-17: street crowd with balloons). Mutually encourage authenticity, creativity, mental health, family and LGBTQ advocacy.

C: transgender woman from Sweden; moved away from home country ~2019; began transitioning ~2020. Supportive friends known since ~2019 helped through difficulties/tough breakup; friends, family, mentors essential to transition/self-acceptance. Turned 18 in 2013. Favorite color blue (relaxing). Childhood grandmother’s Swedish necklace with cross/heart symbolizes love, faith, strength, roots (photo 2023-06-27); treasures friend’s hand-painted bowl for 18th birthday (2013), colors/pattern/self-expression. Rode horses through fields with father as child; loves horses. Guinea pig Oscar, vegetables favorite; photo eating parsley 2023-08-23.
C career: researching education/counseling/mental health since 2023-05-08; wants to support people with similar struggles, especially trans people, create safe spaces. Personal mental-health struggles and helpful counseling/support groups inspire her. LGBTQ support group 2023-05-07 powerful, inspiring trans stories, acceptance/courage. LGBTQ counseling workshop 2023-06-23 covered therapeutic methods/best practices for trans clients. Spoke at school during 2023-05-29–06-04 about coming out, transition struggles/growth, community participation; empowering, inspired allies. Wants to give others hope and voice to trans community.
C adoption: researching agencies 2023-05-25, chose one to explore for LGBTQ inclusivity/support (unnamed; building/sign photo). Expects single parenthood; wants safe loving home for children in need; hopeful despite challenges, supported by friends/mentors/M. Building future children’s library by 2023-07-06: classics, multicultural stories, educational books; bookcase/books/toys photo. Adoption council meeting 2023-07-14 emotional/inspiring, strengthened resolve. Applied to agencies 2023-08-21–23; advice/assistance group very helpful; excited/nervous but ready for responsibility.
C community: Pride during 2023-06-26–07-02 brought belonging/motivated counseling; cherished acceptance/authenticity without fear. LGBTQ conference 2023-07-10 welcoming, reinforced trans rights/awareness; rights progressed but much work remains. Reported joining LGBTQ youth mentorship 2023-07-15–16; mentors trans teenager on confidence/positive strategies; also described attending June 2023 LGBT Pride with mentee, favorite moment their face lighting up at support (rainbow-umbrella photo 2023-07-17). Joined Connected LGBTQ Activists 2023-07-18: diverse group, regular meetings/events/campaigns for rights, expression/support. Missed city parade 2023-07-15–16. Attended Pride 2023-08-11 (street/balloons photo). Upsetting encounter with religious conservatives hiking, reported 2023-08-17; support sustains confidence.
C art/books: learning piano by 2023-07-03. Planned LGBTQ painting show August 2023 (completion not confirmed). Tree/bright sun painting shared 2023-07-17 inspired by LGBTQ center’s unity/strength. Art advocates inclusivity, tells trans story, explores changing body/identity, imperfections and healing. “Embracing Identity” shared 2023-08-14: woman red shirt, warmth/love/self-acceptance; also woman holding cow painting photo. Self-portrait painted 2023-08-14–20, blue-faced woman, shared 2023-08-23; liberating/empowering/therapeutic. Loves books for guidance/self-discovery; “Becoming Nicole” by Amy Ellis Nutt gave hope, connection, self-acceptance/support.

M: husband, children; married ~2018, five years by 2023-06-09; C didn’t know her at wedding. Wedding full of loved ones/love/joy; favorite marrying partner/promising forever; flowers important decor, reminders of day (photos bride/bouquet, flowered chairs, greenhouse ceremony, beach couple). Family helped during unspecified move. Youngest daughter’s wobbly first steps unforgettable. Two younger children love nature. Pets: black dog Oliver, cat Luna (earlier names ambiguous, Oliver confirmed 2023-08-23); another cat Bailey acquired by 2023-08-23. Oliver hid bone in slipper; photo grass/frisbee. Dog with two girls and floor-resting cat photos 2023-07-12. Once fed horse carrot (photo 2023-08-23).
M self-care: swamped childcare/work 2023-05-08; charity mental-health race 2023-05-20 rewarding/thought-provoking. Daily running, reading, violin help stay present for family; self-care work in progress. Longer runs/new shoes by 2023-07-12 relieve stress/clear mind; shoes pink in photos, C called purple. Unnamed book read 2022 inspired pursuing dreams (gold-coin cover shared 2023-07-12). Childhood favorite “Charlotte’s Web,” friendship/compassion.
M creativity: painting lifelong sanctuary, expression/relaxation; special 2022 lake sunrise painting shared 2023-05-08 (photo called sunset). Pottery class signup 2023-07-02; black/white floral bowl shared 2023-07-03; pottery important, therapeutic. Children’s pottery workshop 2023-07-14, pots/dog-face cup. Paint nature together: sunset/palm tree 2023-07-08–09; another similar painting completed by 2023-07-17. Colorful bowl shared 2023-08-17 inspired love of colors/patterns, making people smile. Horse painted on wooden wall shared 2023-08-23; loves animals/horses’ grace. Flowers symbolize growth/beauty/small joys; bouquet blue vase, sunflowers/roses photo 2023-07-15.

M family outdoors: summer camping tradition marshmallows/stories/fire, summer highlight. Mountain camping 2023-06-19–25: nature, campfire, summit hike. Forest camping 2023-07-08–09; quiet weekend 2023-07-15–16. Loves mountain hiking/forest exploration and beach camping. In 2022 camped watching Perseid meteors, lying under stars/making wishes, awe/connection. Beach visits usually 1–2/year; recent by 2023-07-20, photo three children/kite, sandcastle; children’s happiness favorite. Museum 2023-07-05, dinosaur bones favorite (water-play photo). Daughter’s birthday celebrated at Matt Patterson concert with children evening 2023-08-13, loved voice/music/breeze/smiles (audience/band photos; “all are welcome” sign).
Other photos: M family man/little girl at waterfall, picnic couple blanket 2023-06-09; C supportive gathering yard family, picnic women blanket park shared 2023-07-06; dog in boat 2023-07-12; baby white crib/blue blanket 2023-07-20.
2023-08-17 M proposed summer family outing; C suggested family outing or nature trip just two friends; excited but no date/place/activity fixed.

PEOPLE
Caroline (C): transgender woman from Sweden; moved abroad ~2019, began transition ~2020; turned 18 in 2013. Friends known since ~2019 supported difficulties/breakup. Friends/family/mentors helped self-acceptance; lost friends transitioning but current relationships more genuine. Blue favorite/calming. Childhood horseback rides in fields with father; loves horses. Guinea pig Oscar loves vegetables (parsley photo 2023-08-23).
Melanie (M/Mel): working mother, husband, son and younger children including youngest daughter. Married ~2018 before C knew her. Family sustained a move, her greatest motivation/support. Dog Oliver hid bone in slipper; cats Luna and Bailey. Values nature, creativity, self-care. Running relieves stress, increasing distance 2023-07; pink shoes (C called purple). Plays violin, childhood clarinet; Bach, Mozart, Ed Sheeran “Perfect.” Childhood favorite “Charlotte’s Web” for compassion/friendship. Art since ~2016, landscapes/still lifes; painting/pottery therapeutic. Both cherish supportive friendship.

C GOALS/COMMUNITY
2023-05-07 LGBTQ support group inspiring; trans stories foster courage/acceptance. Considering education/counseling mental-health career 2023-05–07, particularly helping trans people; struggles/support motivate safe spaces. LGBTQ counseling therapeutic-methods workshop 2023-06-23. M praises empathy.
Adoption: researching 2023-05-25; chose unnamed inclusive LGBTQ-supporting agency. Expects single parenthood, wants safe loving home for children in need; friends/mentors/M supportive. Building children’s library by 2023-07-06: classics, multicultural, educational. Inspiring emotional adoption council meeting 2023-07-14. Applied to agencies 2023-08-21–23, excited/nervous, ready for motherhood; adoption advice group helpful. Contacted mentor by 2023-10-13. Passed adoption agency interviews 2023-10-20, announced excited/thankful 2023-10-22: major step toward family. Wants to shelter children lacking homes, give back through love/acceptance; family includes blood/chosen ties. Long self-acceptance journey and invaluable friends/family/role-model support motivate passing support on; comforting others/helping growth brings joy, empowering positive difference. Honesty/authenticity freeing, enables contentment. M encouraging, believes children will be supported/happy.
M’s buddy adopted in 2022 after long process, happy with child. M considering adoption, undecided; C advised research, agency/lawyer, references, financial info, medical checks, preparation for emotional wait; M plans research.
2023-05-29–06-04 school transition/inclusion/allies talk empowered C. Pride 2023-06-26–07-02 belonging; highlight trans teenage mentee lighting up at support. LGBTQ conference 2023-07-10 reinforced advocacy. Youth mentoring joined/reported 2023-07-15–16: confidence/positive strategies. Connected LGBTQ Activists joined 2023-07-18, diverse meetings/events/campaigns. Missed city parade 2023-07-15–16, attended 2023-08-11. C/M attended Pride with friends in 2022.
By 2023-08-28 volunteering LGBTQ+ youth center, shares story against isolation, admires resilience/connections; continuing, organizing September children’s talent show. Upsetting religious-conservatives hike encounter reported 2023-08-17; incident/attempted apology discussed 2023-08-25.
2023-10-06 trans poetry reading safe/empowering, electric support, celebrated identities/stories, posters inspired art. 2023-10-13 classroom poster and “trans lives matter” sign photos. M never attended poetry reading.

ART/MUSIC/KEEPSAKES
C art since ~17; drawing/painting explores trans identity, body changes, imperfections/authenticity, catharsis; likes drawing flowers. Acoustic guitar since ~2018, singing emotional outlet, learning piano 2023-07. Sara Bareilles “Brave” = courage/life choices. Loves Amy Ellis Nutt’s “Becoming Nicole”: hope/connection/acceptance/support. Treasures grandmother’s childhood cross/heart necklace from Sweden (love/faith/strength/roots), friend’s hand-painted 18th-birthday bowl.
C art: 2023-07-17 bright sun/tree inspired LGBTQ center unity/strength. LGBTQ art show planned August; organizing September show by 2023-08-25. 2023-08-14 “Embracing Identity,” woman red shirt = warmth/self-love/acceptance; also woman holding cow painting. Blue-faced self-portrait 2023-08-14–20 empowering. Beach sunset painting 2023-08-25. Church stained glass = internal key to potential, time/growth/change/trans journey, unity in differences. Rainbow/eagle mural = courage/freedom/resilience; neighborhood Pride rainbow sidewalk inspires art. 2023-09-13 red/blue painting = binary genders, mixed colors break rigidity, self-love; also heart painting. 2023-10-13 experimenting abstract/no plan, expressing feelings; woman-in-dress drawing inspired poetry reading = freedom/authenticity, embracing womanhood, ongoing growth. 2023-10-22 shared green/yellow clock photo and painting with word “happiness.”
M painted meaningful lake sunrise in 2022 (photo described sunset). Pottery signup 2023-07-02, black/white flower bowl 2023-07-03. Family palm-tree sunset painting 2023-07-08–09; children’s pottery workshop 2023-07-14, dog-face cup. Colorful smile-inducing bowl 2023-08-17; horse painting 2023-08-23; flower plate made 2023-08-24; sunflower canvas 2023-08-25, planned autumn paintings. Bowls/starfish photo 2023-09-13; C hadn’t tried pottery, open to it.
M injured 2023-09 (cause/type unknown), stopped pottery, misses peace/self-expression. By 2023-10-13 okay, painting and reading C-recommended book (title unstated). Sunset painted 2023-10-02–08, pink sky/calming colors for calm. Abstract wall painting blue background/streaks, vibrant yet serene, peace/tranquility; blue calms M too.
2023-10-21 M bought wooden couple figurines reminding her of family love; shared dolls on table photo 2023-10-22.

FAMILY/OUTINGS
M mental-health charity race 2023-05-20; daily self-care. Mountain camping 2023-06-19–25, summit hike/marshmallows. Loves forest hikes, beach camping, summer campfires/stories. Camping 2023-07-08–09, quiet 2023-07-15–16; another forest trip ~2023-08. In 2022 family watched Perseid shower camping, lying making wishes, unforgettable awe. Cherishes youngest daughter’s first steps.
2023-07-05 museum dinosaurs/bones favorite; kids water-play photo. Beach 1–2 times/year; July photos three kids/kite/sandcastle. Wedding greenhouse ceremony/flowers; favorite marrying/promising forever. Daughter’s birthday 2023-08-13 Matt Patterson concert with kids; M loves live music, enjoyed Summer Sounds pop performance by 2023-08-28. Family shelter volunteering 2023-08-24 moving; park 2023-08-27. Café outing 2023-09-09–10 (later called park), alarming door sign precaution only; C biked with friends that weekend. Proposed family outing or C/M nature trip 2023-08-17, no date/place.
2023-10-14–15 Grand Canyon road trip: accident at start involving M’s son, thankfully okay. M terrified/family freaked, other kids scared, parents reassured brother would be okay. Kids ultimately enjoyed canyon. Accident reminded M life precious, cherish family; admires children’s resilience, wishes equally resilient. Reported 2023-10-20; photos car dashboard/steering wheel/white cloth and two kids on rocky cliff over canyon.
2023-10-19 family trail outing to relax after trip, kids loved; woman/child trail photo shared 2023-10-20, also sunset over water. Nature resets/recharges M; camping peace/serenity, being present together, bonding over campfire stories/nature; birds/fresh air refresh soul. C empathized about accident, grateful son safe, affirmed family strength/nature’s restoration.
